sources_fetched.title: The AI Work Platform for People & Agents | monday.com

record.name: Monday.com
record.one_liner: Monday.com provides a GraphQL platform API and OAuth2/personal API token authentication for building work management integrations.

auth.notes: The API supports personal V2 API tokens passed in the Authorization header as well as OAuth 2.0 / OAuth 2.1 for apps.

access.notes: Developers can create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.

api_surface.notes: The platform API is built with GraphQL and supports webhooks and official SDKs for NodeJS and Python.

mcp.notes: Provides a hosted MCP url and developer MCP to connect agents and IDEs.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials are readily available via a free developer account, and the platform API is thoroughly documented with GraphQL, SDKs, and webhook support.

evidence.claim: Mentions native MCP and hosted MCP URL, Model/Agents API, Platform API, and App framework.
Describes personal V2 API tokens and passing them in the Authorization header.
States the platform API is built with GraphQL and users can create a free developer account.
Describes OAuth 2.0 and OAuth 2.1 support and scopes.
Describes webhook configuration and event subscriptions.
Details official SDKs for NodeJS and Python and storage/CLI capabilities.
